text: You are speaking with the automated emergency assistant of 112. All operators are busy, so I will take your details and pass them on right away. Tell me what happened, and where.
text_en: You are speaking with the automated emergency assistant of 112. All operators are busy, so I will take your details and pass them on right away. Tell me what happened, and where.

text: There is a wildfire near Defne, smoke is getting close
text_en: There is a wildfire near Defne, smoke is getting close

text: Stay indoors with the doors and windows shut, and block the gaps with wet cloths. If smoke gets in, cover your mouth and nose with a wet cloth and stay low. If you must go out, wear an FFP2 mask if you have one. If anyone has trouble breathing or chest pain, tell me now. I understand. What is the name of the street or the nearest landmark where you are?
